name: web-red-pixel-glow-code-icon-hero-on-laptop-with-ghost-title
title: Black laptop with a glowing red code-bracket icon over a pixel-grid glow and a ghost 'codable' title on a pink plinth
whatItIs: A black-and-red scene with a big ghost 'codable' at the top, a laptop showing a black site with a glowing red hexagon holding a code symbol, a dark pixel-square grid glowing red at the edges, the headline 'Build, launch, and grow. We handle the code.' and pill tags (SaaS, UI/UX Design, 2026) at the bottom on a pink plinth.
whatItMeans: Techy and intense; red glow on black feels like a compile-time heat.
techniques: Light the scene from below in red.
Use a pixel-square grid as texture.
Set a ghost title behind the laptop.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of dark squares lit by coloured light.
An icon inside a six-sided shape.
Pills listing type, discipline and year.
